items: o Launched: 25 December 2019
o Implemented: 1 April 2020
o Ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
o Duration: 2020-2024
o Scheme Type: Central Sector Scheme
o Budget: Rs. 6000 crores (Rs. 3000 crore loan from World Bank + Rs. 3000 crore from the
Central Government)
 Objectives:
 Improve groundwater levels in distressed states through better management.
 Promote water conservation and efficient usage.
 Coverage:
 Targeted States: Haryana, Gujarat, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Rajasthan,
Uttar Pradesh.
 Rajasthan: 22 blocks in 17 districts.
 Districts Covered: 78 in total across 7 states.

 Community Participation: Local communities involved in planning and management.
 Capacity Building: Training for officials and community members.
 Water-Efficient Practices: Adoption of water-saving technologies in agriculture.
 Monitoring: Use of GIS and remote sensing for groundwater tracking.
